decisive_items: 50% to 90% diffuse stenosis in proximal to mid-LAD
polymorphic ventricular tachycardia during presyncope episode
response.rationale: The patient has significant coronary artery stenosis on angiography, which directly explains the syncope and polymorphic VT. The normal LVEF and absence of structural heart disease features argue against cardiomyopathy. Long QT is excluded by normal QTc, and ARVC lacks supporting evidence.

rejected.why: QTc is normal (403 ms), not prolonged, so Long QT Syndrome is not supported.
No evidence of right ventricular structural abnormalities or characteristic ECG changes of ARVC; polymorphic VT is more consistent with ischemia.
